Loss report: gitea -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Tekton schedules pods, not runner labels)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.pull_request: same-repository pull requests only; Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (the filter admits only pull requests from this repository, because the code of a fork would run with every secret of the Task; GitHub Actions withholds secrets from fork runs. Remove the head.repo term of the filter to accept forks; create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches: CEL interceptor filter on the ref (the EventListener serves GitHub webhooks only)
